_comment: Image variant definitions for bazzite-nix builds

variants.name: string

versioned: string (supports {canonical}, {branch}, {major}, {sha256} placeholders; {sha256} is resolved at push time from the built image's digest, not from tags.csv)

variants.tags_default: If 'tags' is omitted, generates: [branch-canonical, branch-major, branch] (mirrors the unstable variant)

_schema._output: The resolve_variant record plus needs_build; aggregate_variants deletes needs_build before these reach build.yml:

output_fields.build_script: string - the build script to use
output_fields.suffix: string - the name suffix (may be empty)
output_fields.version_tag: string - the version this build embeds and pushes: {branch}-{canonical}, upstream's version verbatim unless our registry already holds that tag, which adds a minor version
output_fields.canonical_tag: string - our bare version (upstream's version bumped by one, walked past tags we already published)
output_fields.upstream_version: string - upstream's own version, what the build-needed check compares
output_fields.upstream_tag: string - the upstream git tag naming upstream_version, carried as org.opencontainers.image.parent-version
output_fields.tag_family: string - which naming family resolved (prefixed or bare-version)
output_fields.collision_detected: boolean - our registry already held the bumped tag, so the walk went further
output_fields.latest: boolean - this variant also publishes the 'latest' alias
output_fields.target_image: string - the local image reference the build works against
output_fields.tag: string - the branch name the tags are built from (the variant name)
output_fields.tags: string - comma-separated list of tags to apply
output_fields.needs_build: boolean - whether this variant needs rebuilding
